python3 << 'EOF'
# Department of Commerce total outlays (on-budget + off-budget) for FY 2016-2024
# Data from Treasury Bulletin FFO-3 tables

data = {
    2016: 9162,
    2017: 10303,
    2018: 8561,
    2019: 11326,
    2020: 15918,
    2021: 13135,
    2022: 11734,
    2023: 12045,
    2024: 14831
}

# Extract values and sort
values = sorted(data.values())
print("Sorted values:", values)
print("Number of data points:", len(values))

# Tukey exclusive median method for Q1:
# 1. Find median (Q2)
# 2. Q1 = median of lower half (excluding median if odd number)
# 3. Q3 = median of upper half (excluding median if odd number)

n = len(values)
median_idx = n // 2
print(f"Median index: {median_idx}")

# Lower half (exclusive - exclude median if odd)
if n % 2 == 0:
    lower_half = values[:median_idx]
    upper_half = values[median_idx:]
else:
    lower_half = values[:median_idx]
    upper_half = values[median_idx + 1:]

print(f"Lower half: {lower_half}")
print(f"Upper half: {upper_half}")

# Calculate median of lower half for Q1
def median_odd(vals):
    n = len(vals)
    mid = n // 2
    return vals[mid]

def median_even(vals):
    n = len(vals)
    return (vals[n//2 - 1] + vals[n//2]) / 2

if len(lower_half) % 2 == 0:
    q1 = median_even(lower_half)
else:
    q1 = median_odd(lower_half)

if len(upper_half) % 2 == 0:
    q3 = median_even(upper_half)
else:
    q3 = median_odd(upper_half)

print(f"\nQ1 (Tukey exclusive): {q1}")
print(f"Q2 (median): {median_even(values) if n % 2 == 0 else values[median_idx]}")
print(f"Q3 (Tukey exclusive): {q3}")

# Round to nearest hundredths
q1_rounded = round(q1, 2)
print(f"\nQ1 rounded to nearest hundredths: {q1_rounded}")
EOF
